shortDescription: The FTSE 100 Index is picking up 14 points or 0.13 percent on Thursday.Gains are led by British American Tobacco (2.00%), JD Sports Fashion (1.68%) and Antofagasta (1.31%).Biggest losers are Standard Life (-3.29%), Kingfisher (-2.45%) and Babcock International (-1.41%).
